overview: The Medford Historical Commission accepted demolition applications for 31 South Street and 180 Lincoln Road, and determined that 8 Hamlin Avenue is not historically significant. Commissioners also reviewed proposed facade alterations and additions to the Saltonstall building at 121 Riverside Avenue, agreeing to submit comments for site plan review.

items.title: 31 South Street Demolition Application
items.summary: The commission voted to accept the demolition application for 31 South Street as to form for review next month.

items.title: 180 Lincoln Road Demolition Application and Form B Allocation
items.summary: The commission accepted the demolition application for 180 Lincoln Road as to form and approved expending $500 to commission an MHC Form B inventory form.

items.title: Determination of Significance: 8 Hamlin Avenue
items.summary: A motion to determine 8 Hamlin Avenue historically significant failed, meaning the building is found not significant due to loss of architectural integrity.

items.title: Site Plan Review: 121 Riverside Avenue (Saltonstall Building)
items.summary: Commissioners discussed planned renovations and facade changes to Medford Housing Authority's Saltonstall building and agreed to draft and submit a comment letter.

items.title: Comprehensive Master Plan and Preservation Scope
items.summary: The commission reviewed its proposed roles in the city's comprehensive plan, emphasizing that expanded responsibilities require a designated city preservation planner rather than volunteer commissioners.

items.title: Updates on Demolition Delay and CPA Projects
items.summary: Hayward provided updates on active demo delay properties, masonry sourcing challenges delaying a CPA stone wall project, and sorting archaeological artifacts.

items.title: Survey and Planning Grants
items.summary: The commission discussed closeout delays with the finance department for Winter Hill, progress on the Brickyards project, and potential areas to target for next year's survey grant.

items.title: Meeting Minutes Approval
items.summary: The commission approved the meeting minutes for October 3, 2022, and September 12, 2022.
